title: Little Girl Holding White Chicken, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-1940s black and white snapshot depicting a smiling young girl holding a large white chicken in her arms. She is standing outdoors in front of a dense wall of ivy or geranium foliage, dressed in a light-colored dress with white socks and dark shoes. The photograph captures a sweet slice of mid-century suburban or rural domestic life.
